responsibility: This file is the DFA pipeline model for Loongson GS464 cores. It describes a dual-ALU, dual-FALU, single-memory scheduling model with target-specific reservations for integer, branch, HI/LO, multiply/divide, load/store, and FP arithmetic, including the distinction that only one floating unit handles compare and conversion while arithmetic can prefer the second unit, allowing GCC to tune scheduling for the loongson3a/gs464 core.
